title: Cheap rose
text: Cheap rose. I got this today & was very disappointed!!  I really wanted a glass rose, but thought a good plastic won’t break!  It feels like paper it’s so flimsy!!  I would never recommend this!  I figured something irredesant would be durable to be able to show the colors!  I am very disappointed!!!  I don’t even want this!  Made very cheap!  The box is nicer then the rose, and I have no use for it!  So bummed!!
